about: Where Recall finds cards. Each source is read when its Import button is pressed; adding a source is one entry here, adding a kind of source is one function in recall_core.IMPORTERS. Root paths may start with ~ (the home folder) or {forge} (the Forge folder); a source with an "app" is offered only when that app is installed.

sources.label: Study Companion question banks
sources.about: Every question in each course's questions/*.jsonl: the question on the front, the answer and its worked steps on the back. One deck per course.

sources.label: Cards written in Study Companion notes
sources.about: Any line in a course's notes written as front :: back. One deck per course.
